newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $65 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle brisk at $65 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area early Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were $1.00 per cwt higher. Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 33,000 slaughter steers and 20,400 heifers; 77,900 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 22,800 formulated and 300 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 65.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 64.00 to mostly 65.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1050 64.00.
Wk to Date - 77,900 Week Ago - 67,600 Year Ago - 24,000
